tasks.short: Verify regulatory compliance of transaction reporting

steps.what: Open the transaction report and its fields
Mark report fields that differ from the source trade
Verify regulatory compliance of the exceptions

tasks.design: The transaction report is opened from {ERP} against the fields {GOV_PORTAL} requires. A field is marked when it is empty or differs from the source trade. The manager verifies what that means for compliance. A complete field list is not itself a compliance opinion.
tasks.previous_blocker: The report was read line by line against a printed trade blotter.
tasks.enabler_now: The source trade and the report fields are both stored, so a difference is a comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a difference is acceptable under the rule stays with the manager.

ambition.what: A report shows its field gaps the day it is built, and the manager still verifies it.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the exceptions before signing the verification.

evidence.claim: A report check compares stored fields, and the manager verifies the regulatory consequence. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a transaction report is ready and ends when the manager has verified it.
A field has report id, name, and value, produced by the report. The source trade has the same name and a value. A name with no source value is marked, not filled.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the authority's field list matches the one stored here.
research_questions: Which reports have exceptions the manager has not verified?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: verification the manager signed for that report

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts fields that can be compared with a stored trade. The compliance verification stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Review offering documents for regulatory compliance

steps.what: Open the offering documents and the rule list
Mark marketing lines whose figures differ from the facts
Review the materials for regulatory compliance
Release the offering the manager reviewed

tasks.design: The offering and its marketing materials are opened from {DOCS} with the required sections and the stored facts. A line is marked when a figure differs from the stored fact or a required section is absent. The manager reviews compliance. The marking is not a statement that the document is allowed. Release waits for that review.
tasks.previous_blocker: The review was a read-through of a long file against a checklist kept elsewhere.
tasks.enabler_now: The required sections and the facts are stored, so a missing section or a stale figure is a comparison.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the document complies stays the manager's review.

ambition.what: An offering shows its figure gaps the day a fact changes, and the manager still reviews it.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees the differences before reviewing.

evidence.claim: A document check compares stored facts, and the manager reviews compliance before release. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an offering is ready to review and ends when the manager has reviewed it.
A section has document id and fact id. A figure in the text is compared with the stored fact. A section with no text is marked absent.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the rule list includes every section this authority currently asks for.

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts lines that can be compared with a stored fact. The compliance review stays with the manager, and release waits for it.

tasks.short: Identify target investors for a specific fund

steps.what: Open the specific fund and the known names
Identify group and individual target investors
Note investors the manager chose not to target

tasks.design: Names the manager has already recorded for this fund are opened from {CRM}. The manager identifies which group or individual investors to target. The list does not score or rank anyone, and it does not add a person the manager did not record. A target is the manager's choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Targets were a private note, separate from the names already known to the fund.
tasks.enabler_now: The known names are stored, so the manager chooses among people already in view.
tasks.still_hard: Who is a real target for this fund stays the manager's judgement.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees known names before choosing targets, and nobody is scored.

evidence.claim: Known names can be opened, and identifying targets stays with the manager, with no score. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the fund is looking for investors and ends when the manager has identified the targets.
A name has fund id and investor id, entered by the manager. The system does not propose an investor.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether a name in the list is still someone the fund may contact.
research_questions: Which known names were not targeted?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening names the manager already recorded. Identifying targets stays with the manager, and no one is scored.

steps.what: Open accounting and operations close activities
Direct the departments on those activities
Note activities the departments have not finished

tasks.design: Close activities are opened from {ERP}. The manager directs the accounting and operations departments in a meeting. The list is of activities, not of people, and it does not assign work by a score. What is unfinished is noted by the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: The close status was collected by asking each person, because the list was not shared.
tasks.enabler_now: The activity list shows what the close still needs, so the meeting starts from that list.
tasks.still_hard: Directing people, and which delay matters, stay with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the open activities before directing the departments.

evidence.claim: An activity list can be opened, and directing the departments stays with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a close period is under way and ends when the manager has directed the open activities.
An activity has period id, name, and status, produced by the close checklist. A status is not a score of a person.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether every department updates the same activity list.

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a list that already exists. Directing the departments stays with the manager, and nobody is scored.

role.altitude: Transaction reports are compared with the source trade, then verified by the manager. Offering lines are compared with stored facts, then reviewed. Target investors are chosen by the manager from names already known. Department direction stays in person.
reach: A reviewer sees which report fields differed.
An accounting lead sees which activities are open.
skills_to_grow: Do not call a field check a compliance opinion.
Do not score an investor or a colleague.
role.ambitious_version: A report shows its gaps the day it is built, and the manager still verifies it.
